description: No2SQL MCP server for inferring SQL schema and ER diagrams from MongoDB databases.
name: io.github.ptalati015/no2sql

environmentVariables.name: NO2SQL_MONGO
environmentVariables.description: MongoDB connection string used by the No2SQL MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NO2SQL_ALLOWED_DATABASES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of database names the server may read. Leave empty to allow every database not blocked by NO2SQL_BLOCK_SYSTEM_DATABASES.

environmentVariables.name: NO2SQL_BLOCK_SYSTEM_DATABASES
environmentVariables.description: When true, the MongoDB system databases admin, config and local are blocked.
